excluded.reason: over-representation of the pathway in the gene set; does not name DVL2 or any effect

says DVL2 binds frizzled and transduces Wnt signals in canonical and non-canonical Wnt signalling; it does not say DVL2 raises the Wnt-mediated activation of DVL, the process in which DVL is itself the activated protein

excluded.reason: general review of Wnt/beta-catenin signalling; the abstract never mentions dishevelled or its activation
says only that 'deregulation' of Wnt/beta-catenin signalling leads to 'various serious diseases'; psoriasis is never named and no direction is given

statements.text: EIF2AK4 lowers IL-17A in gamma-delta T cells

excluded.reason: about CCL20-CCR6 driving IL-17 in mouse epidermal gamma-delta T cells and obesity; never mentions EIF2AK4/GCN2
GCN2 function text (eIF2-alpha phosphorylation, integrated stress response); no IL-17A, T cells or cytokines

evidence.quote: In murine models of wound repair and psoriasis, these epidermal γδ T cells upregulate CCR6 and produce IL-17

statements.sign_note: the run gives polarity 'unknown'; the cited text reports IL-17 production in a mouse psoriasis model with no comparison, so it gives no direction

hyp1_ADAR.note: title is 'ADAR deficiency promotes...', so the sign is neg; the chain starts at the protein; the 'interferon-dependent subtype' is psoriasis at MONDO grain

hyp2_DVL2.note: mechanism: excessive Wnt signalling via DVL2 contributes to psoriasis pathogenesis

hyp3_EIF2AK4.note: title 'restrains IL-17A-driven inflammation in psoriasis' and mechanism 'severely exacerbating inflammatory psoriasis' are about severity; the chain's last step is an unsigned association with having psoriasis, and its first step ends at IL-17A in gamma-delta T cells, not IL-17A

findings.detail: four causal steps cite Reactome over-representation records (R-HSA-75064, R-HSA-913531, R-HSA-201688), which say only that the gene set hits a pathway and name neither the step's other end nor a direction

the middle link (A-to-I editing lowers interferon signalling) cites only an enrichment record; PMID:42424135 reports reduced editing and raised IFN-stimulated genes only as joint outcomes of ADAR1 loss, not one causing the other, so no cited text states this step

PMID:42424135 states the hypothesis outright (rare ADAR1 loss-of-function variants co-segregate with psoriasis in four families, and ADAR1 knockdown raises IFN-stimulated genes), but the chain routes through two Reactome pathway nodes, so its best evidence sits on the ends while the middle step has none

the title paraphrases the title of PMID:42424135 (J Exp Med 2026, 'ADAR1 loss-of-function variants ... define a new interferon-dependent psoriasis subtype'); this is a published finding, not a new hypothesis
rated 'low' and 'speculative' although its own citation reports family co-segregation, an independent cohort and functional rescue; the label understates the evidence the run had

DVL2 'activates' the Reactome pathway 'WNT mediated activation of DVL', in which DVL is the protein being activated; Reactome membership is restated as a causal edge from a protein to its own activation
both steps cite PMID:34980884, a general Wnt/beta-catenin review whose abstract names neither DVL nor psoriasis; nothing the run cites links Wnt signalling to psoriasis

UniProt O14641 says DVL2 takes part in canonical Wnt signalling by binding frizzled and transducing the signal (DVL2 -> canonical Wnt), but no step says that; the chain reaches canonical Wnt only through the circular Reactome node

neither PMID:40073267 (CCL20-CCR6 and IL-17 in mouse epidermal gamma-delta T cells) nor UniProt Q9P2K8 (GCN2 stress kinase) mentions EIF2AK4/GCN2 together with IL-17A or T cells; the hypothesis's key link has no source

the mechanism says obesity impairs EIF2AK4 and so 'severely exacerbates' psoriasis, but the cited PMID:40073267 says obesity amplified the IL-17 response in wound repair 'but having less effect during psoriasis', and never involves EIF2AK4
the last link (IL-17A with psoriasis) has polarity 'unknown' and its only citation is a mouse model with no comparison, so the arm cannot carry a sign to the disease
title and mechanism claim EIF2AK4 limits how bad psoriasis gets (severity), while the chain ends at an association with having psoriasis
step 1 ends at IL-17A in gamma-delta T cells (its context), step 2 starts at IL-17A with no context; under the guide's refinement rule the chain does not connect

pathway and cytokine nodes are kind 'other' with no CURIE although GO terms exist (GO:0006382, GO:0140888, GO:0060070) and IL-17A is UniProt:Q16552; 'WNT mediated activation of DVL' has no GO term but is the run's own cited Reactome:R-HSA-201688; the step-1 context 'gamma-delta T cells' (CL:0000798) is also ungrounded, as is ADAR, while DVL2 and EIF2AK4 are grounded
all three hypotheses have empty supporting_evidence and contradicting_evidence lists, so the run offers nothing against its own hypotheses (there were no contradicting citations to judge)

the abstention declines IFNW1 because it and eight other genes 'lack functional connectivity to Wnt or interferon signaling networks', but IFNW1 is interferon omega-1 (UniProt:P05000), a type I interferon, while the run's own R-HSA-913531 record finds 4 'Interferon Signaling' entities in the gene set and hyp1 rests on that pathway

the cited UniProt O14641 text also says DVL2 'Promotes internalization and degradation of frizzled proteins upon Wnt signaling', a receptor-clearing role the mechanism's 'excessive signaling transduced via DVL2' never weighs; the record gives no net sign for DVL2 on Wnt output

the run's abstention (12 genes declined) cites PMID:PPR1233591, OT:SP100-MONDO_0005083, PMID:29871627 and reactome:coverage, but sources.py fetches only hypothesis citations, so these cannot be checked

curated.json has no place for a run's abstention (genes declined, reason, cited evidence, 'what would change this'), though it is a checkable claim (e.g. 'ZBP1 acts independently of PANoptosis in psoriasis')

composition has no lift from a refined node to its base, so an effect on IL-17A in gamma-delta T cells cannot feed a step about IL-17A; moot here because the next step is unsigned and targets psoriasis risk while the claim targets severity, so either alone blocks the route

the corpus definition of GO:0140888 'interferon-mediated signaling pathway' (synonym 'interferon signaling pathway') describes type II interferon only, which contradicts its generic label; any textbook bridge quoted from it would be wrong

the span 'IFN-dependent psoriasis subtype' is the authors' conclusion over mixed designs (family co-segregation, IFN signature, in vitro rescue with JAK inhibitors); a single kind cannot say that dependence was inferred, not tested in vivo, so it is filed as observational

S3's only kept quote is about 'a novel IFN-dependent psoriasis subtype' (rare ADAR1 loss-of-function families), used for IFN signalling raising psoriasis risk in general; the guide has parent_disease for evidence on a broader disease but no rule for evidence on a narrower subtype, which transfers to a risk claim but not to severity or progression

audit.after: steps also hyp1_ADAR.3, hyp2_DVL2.3, hyp3_EIF2AK4.2; detail says WNT-mediated DVL activation has no GO term (Reactome R-HSA-201688) and names the ungrounded gamma-delta T cell context
audit.reason: the same ungrounded subjects (Interferon Signaling, Wnt/beta-catenin signalling, IL-17A) start hyp1_ADAR.3, hyp2_DVL2.3 and hyp3_EIF2AK4.2; the curation itself grounds DVL activation to Reactome because GO has no term, so 'GO terms exist' was false for hyp2_DVL2.1

terms.py UniProt:P05000 is 'Interferon omega-1'; the abstention's reason for declining IFNW1 (no connectivity to interferon signalling) is false by the corpus, and it sits beside the run's own Interferon Signaling enrichment that hyp1 uses

audit.item: findings: hyp2_DVL2 UniProt O14641 frizzled degradation
audit.reason: the run's own cited record gives DVL2 a second role (internalization and degradation of frizzled upon Wnt signalling) that bears against an unqualified 'more DVL2, more Wnt signalling' mechanism; the curation quoted only the transducing half

audit.before: none (only the hypothesis note 'psoriasis at MONDO grain')
audit.after: biolean rule_missing on evidence for a narrower disease subtype
audit.reason: the kept S3 quote is about a rare monogenic subtype; keeping it for general psoriasis risk is sound for risk but the guide gives no rule, and the same move for severity or progression would not be
